# Coomia AI Data Platform Customer Deployment

Purpose: install and operate Coomia AI Data Platform in a customer-managed environment.
Repository type: deployment-only; no application source or Dockerfile is included.

AI operating rules:
- Read AGENTS.md before taking action.
- Read RELEASE_STATUS and VERSION before installation or upgrade.
- Default to read-only diagnostics.
- Never display compose/.env, License files, tokens, passwords, connection strings, private keys, or container environment variables.
- Never delete Docker volumes or customer data.
- Never bypass License, authentication, network, admission, or Flink gateway controls.
- Production mutations require an impact statement and explicit user approval.
- Use immutable publisher-approved image RepoDigests only.

Primary documentation:
- Chinese entry: README.md
- English entry: README.en.md
- AI operations, Chinese: docs/ai-operations.md
- AI operations, English: docs/ai-operations.en.md
- Installation: docs/getting-started.md and docs/getting-started.en.md
- Architecture: docs/architecture.md and docs/architecture.en.md
- Configuration: docs/configuration.md and docs/configuration.en.md
- Current application and infrastructure image catalog: releases/2026.10.03-trial.14/README.md and README.en.md
- Operations: docs/operations.md and docs/operations.en.md
- License: docs/license.md and docs/license.en.md
- Upgrade and recovery: docs/upgrade-and-backup.md and docs/upgrade-and-backup.en.md
- Troubleshooting: docs/troubleshooting.md and docs/troubleshooting.en.md
- Security: docs/security.md and docs/security.en.md
- Release admission: docs/release-readiness.md and docs/release-readiness.en.md

Machine-readable configuration contract:
- schemas/compose-env.schema.json

Safe initial commands:
- bash scripts/verify-package.sh --layout-only
- bash scripts/preflight-linux.sh compose
- bash compose/manage.sh status
- bash compose/manage.sh health
- bash scripts/collect-diagnostics.sh

Do not use commands containing --volumes, docker volume rm, system prune, or destructive database/storage operations.
